Whilst we stayed at the Intercontinental, we ate breakfast here every single day. The buffet has one of the widest varieties of any hotel we’ve every stayed at. We particular liked the fact there were speciality chefs at each station. There was choice of Vietnamese specialities, Asian and European foods. 

What made it even more special was the fact the staff were extremely friendly, with the chef greeting us everyday. 

We also had the New Years buffet, which was amazingly thought out. It was perfect for the family. Very well thought out and a great experience. 
Thanks to you all for a beautiful week.
